extreme_layer_notes.precipitation: Variance-reduction (drizzle-smearing) signature confirmed: the blend's 99th percentile is 0.64x the observed 99th percentile, i.e. the forecast field is systematically calmer than reality at the tail. On high-impact days (obs >= 64.5 mm) the calibrated blend averages 48.034 mm against 74.859 mm observed, and the sharpest single model averages 44.693 mm — every model under-forecasts the same events, so max-fusion cannot recover the peak. Peak-preserving fusion is INACTIVE (alpha=0): the validation split did not justify a tail correction, so the system communicates extreme risk through the conformal band and the EVT tail instead of silently sharpening the field.
